issuer: Advisory Committee of the Supreme Court of Missouri / Office of Legal Ethics Counsel
title: Missouri Informal Ethics Opinion 930079
text: QUESTION: Attorney has assumed representation in a case which was previously handled by an attorney who has pled guilty to a felony. Final disposition of the case, including any award of attorney fees, will probably occur after the previous attorney is disbarred. May the current attorney share the attorney fees with the previous attorney? ANSWER: Yes, as long as the previous attorney was licensed at the time the legal services were performed.
